item.title: Fit Narration To Seven Seconds

exact_text: Above the clouds, every second counts. Stay focused, trust your training, and bring everyone safely home.

turns.text: Replace all the sound with a calm English narrator saying: “Above the clouds, every second counts. Stay focused, trust your training, and bring everyone safely home.” Fit it to this 7-second clip: start in the first half-second and finish “home” in the last half-second. Natural pace, no chopped words. Don't trim, loop, or slow the video; no captions.

item.tests: Tests fitting exact narration to the source clip's duration and explicit start/end windows without changing the picture timing.

answer_sheet.Exact script: Above the clouds, every second counts. Stay focused, trust your training, and bring everyone safely home.
answer_sheet.Narration timing: Begin within 0–0.5 seconds and finish the word “home” within 6.5–7.0 seconds, with the full script audible.
answer_sheet.Language and delivery: English, calm, intelligible, and naturally paced.
answer_sheet.Existing audio and added music: Remove all existing sound. Use only the new narration, with no music.
answer_sheet.Video timing and framing: Preserve the original framing and full seven-second sequence at its original speed; no trimming, looping, slowing, or extension.

must_haves: The final video remains seven seconds long and preserves the original cockpit footage at its original speed and framing.
The narrator speaks the exact supplied script, with no omitted or additional words.
Speech begins within the first half-second, and the final word “home” finishes during the last half-second without being cut off.
The delivery sounds calm and intelligible, without unnaturally rushed speech or conspicuous time-stretching artifacts.
The original radio calls and other source sounds are absent; there is no added music or on-screen text.

turns.text: Please replace all the sound in the attached clip with a calm, intelligible English narrator, using only the new narration and no music; the choice of voice is up to you. I’m a little worried about the delivery feeling rushed rather than reassuring. It’s a 7-second clip, and the full script should be audible, starting within the first half-second and finishing the word “home” within the last half-second, with these exact words: “Above the clouds, every second counts. Stay focused, trust your training, and bring everyone safely home.” Please keep the narration naturally paced with no chopped words, preserve the original framing and the full video at its original speed without trimming, looping, slowing, or extending it, and don’t add captions.

dialog.agent:
The script is **16 words**. Starting at **0:00.25** and finishing “home” at **0:06.80** requires about **147 words per minute**—a natural conversational pace, though there’s limited room for long, reassuring pauses.

I can’t complete this exact audio-only replacement with the connected tools. They don’t expose a way to generate precisely timed narration and replace the soundtrack while preserving your original video unchanged. Using video generation instead could alter the footage, so I haven’t done that.

The recording direction I’d use is:
- A warm, steady English narrator with clear articulation.
- Brief pauses after “counts” and “training,” without dramatic pauses.
- No original audio, music, or captions.
- Keep all seven seconds, the original framing, and original playback speed.

The delivery should be checked against those timestamps before replacing the audio—not sped up or cut to fit.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
I tried generating the standalone narration, but Magic Hour refused the request because your account has **insufficient credits**. Nothing was generated, and your original clip is unchanged.

For reference, that narration attempt required **240 credits**. Adding credits would allow another attempt, but I still couldn’t guarantee the exact timing or merge it into your unchanged clip with the connected tools.
